meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本自动生成无人物讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把文章或笔记快速变成视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn articles or notes into video content.

howto.what: 将文章、笔记或主题转化为无真人出镜的解说视频。Claude 会设计每帧的视觉（文字排版、抽象图形、图表、数据可视化），并生成故事板、脚本和最终视频。
howto.when: 当你提供一段文字（文章、笔记、主题等），并希望将其制作成解说视频时触发。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成解说视频。
say.note: Claude 会分析文章，生成故事板和脚本，并构建视频。

say.text: 用这个笔记做一个概念讲解视频。
say.note: Claude 会基于笔记内容设计视觉和叙事。

howto.what_en: Turn arbitrary text (article, notes, topic) into a faceless explainer video. Claude invents visuals per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz) and produces storyboard, script, and final video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a body of text (article, notes, topic) and want it turned into an explainer video.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into an explainer video.
Make a concept breakdown video from these notes.
say_en.note: Claude will design visuals and narrative based on the notes.
